subject: Marketplace listing readiness and co-sell enablement — NebulaOps connector
messages:
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@nebulaops.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Nov 2029 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: NebulaOps connector - interest in marketplace listing + co-sell

Hi Karthik / Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Rajiv and I chatted and the NebulaOps team is ready to start the formal marketplace listing conversation. Key asks from our side:

- Guidance on the evidence bundle you require for GCP/Azure/AWS listings
- Co-sell program logistics (MOU template, referral vs. co-sell coverage, lead routing)
- Typical listing SLA and expected review timeline

We’re aiming for a Jan 2029 pilot with a select customer if we can get the listing and co-sell commit in place. Attaching a short product brief and connector architecture for context.

Attachment: NebulaOps_ProductBrief.pdf (pdf)

Would you prefer a technical sync or a combined commercial + technical kickoff next week?

Thanks,
Samantha
Director, Partnerships
NebulaOps
+samantha.cho@nebulaops.io
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@nebulaops.io>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Nov 2029 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NebulaOps connector - interest in marketplace listing + co-sell

Hi Samantha — great to hear momentum. Happy to run through the steps. High-level asks from our side to scope effort:

1) Evidence checklist: security/compliance artifacts, infra diagram, deployable image references, metering/usage docs. I’ve attached our syndication-evidence checklist to make it concrete.
2) Commercial: draft MOU and a short revenue share matrix (we can start with a referral pilot if you prefer lower lift).
3) Technical: we’ll run a light integration test (connectivity, auth flows, SKU tagging) and a performance verification on a small sample customer tenant.

If those three pillars look good, propose next steps:
- Samantha / Rajiv: upload evidence bundle to the shared Drive by Fri 6 Dec
- Redwood (Olga + Engineering): review evidence and give feedback by Thu 12 Dec
- Commercial sync with Vivek & Ben on Tue 10 Dec to align on pilot terms

Attachment: syndication-evidence-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

Which timezone are you in for scheduling? I can block Tue 10 Dec 9:00–10:00 PT for the commercial sync unless you prefer another slot.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@nebulaops.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@nebulaops.io>
Date: Sun, 01 Dec 2029 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NebulaOps connector - interest in marketplace listing + co-sell

Hi Karthik / Olga —

Thanks for the quick response. We’ll aim to upload the evidence bundle by EOD Thu 6 Dec. To give you a head start I’ve attached the core compliance pack and our metering spec. Highlights:
- SOC-alike report (summary, not full SOC)
- Deployment recipes for GCP and Azure (container + helm charts)
- Usage metering: we emit tokens/requests and provide an ingestion metric compatible with marketplace metering APIs

We do want to pursue a co-sell pilot rather than a pure referral — our field team has one target customer lined up (contact is shared on the Drive).

Attachment: NebulaOps_Syndication_Evidence.pdf (pdf)

One question: do you have a standard co-sell MOU or do you prefer we draft and share?

Best,
Rajiv
Head of Product
NebulaOps
From: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@nebulaops.io>, Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@nebulaops.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Dec 2029 14:26:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NebulaOps connector - interest in marketplace listing + co-sell

Thanks Rajiv — reviewing the PDF now, good detail. A couple of technical asks before we move to formal listing:

- Please provide a minimal test tenant (or demo project) that our validation team can use to run the connectivity and SKU mapping tests.
- Confirm auth modes supported (OIDC/OAuth2 service accounts/managed identities) and a short sample curl or SDK call that demonstrates token exchange.
- Metering mapping: include example event payloads and the metric name you will push to marketplace (we need to map to our SKU taxonomy).

I’ve uploaded a small tech-evidence.csv template to the shared Drive — if you populate that we can accelerate the validation pass. Link and hubspot ref below.

Related links: https://drive.redwood.io/drive/folders/marketplace/nebulaops-evidence, HUBSPOT-RECORD-483922
Attachment: tech-evidence.csv (csv)

Cc’ing Vivek so he has visibility on the pilot ask — Vivek / Ben, can you confirm availability for Tue 10 Dec 9:00–10:00 PT for the commercial sync?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@nebulaops.io>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@nebulaops.io>
Cc: olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: NebulaOps connector - interest in marketplace listing + co-sell

All — thanks for the quick turnaround. Next steps and owners:

1) NebulaOps (Samantha / Rajiv): populate tech-evidence.csv in Drive and upload any missing compliance artifacts by Thu 6 Dec (owner: NebulaOps).
2) Redwood Tech Review (Olga): validation pass completed by Thu 12 Dec (owner: Olga).
3) Commercial (Vivek / Ben): draft co-sell MOU and align pilot economics; commercial sync Tue 10 Dec 9:00–10:00 PT (owner: Vivek).

I’ve attached a starter MOU draft to speed the legal/commercial discussion — feel free to redline. If NebulaOps prefers to start the draft, we’re flexible.

Attachment: co-sell-mou-draft.docx (docx)
DocuSign (optional): https://docusign.redwood.com/start/DEAL-2029-0042

Karthik
Head, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
